why: Measured observation from dual-sensor GPS streams on the already-licensed City Scanner NYC Pilot2 record. Not Bernoulli p_obs. U remains controlled. Not end-to-end MCS. Not a T-Drive network log.
y_aggregation: mean of finite calibrated pm25 inside cell x slot when O=1; do not impute Y when O=0
atomic_unit: 500m_cell x 30min_slot with GPS from PM (kept) or NO2 stream

grid.origin: equirectangular from union GPS bbox of Pilot2 kept PM and Pilot2 NO2 GPS; origin uses floor of min lon/lat; no Y

r_rule: client occupies unit iff that cell has >=1 finite GPS sample from kept PM or from the NO2 stream in that 30min slot
o_rule: O=1 iff the cell-slot has >=1 finite pm25 in [0, 1000]; else O=0. Do not use p_obs=0.35.
label_must_say: measured-O hybrid, controlled U, not jointly measured network, not end-to-end MCS
c1_kill_rule: SCD paired mean relative vs BOTH fedau_window and obsuse_window is <= -0.005 on WorstGroupRMSE OR on RMSE_mu
physical_filters_frozen: PM stream: drop non-finite lat/lon/time; drop pm25 non-finite or outside [0, 1000] from Y and from PM-side O; those GPS rows do not create R
NO2 stream: drop non-finite lat/lon/time from R; NO2 value is not Y under option A
do not retune filters after RMSE
ingest_abort_if: measured O=0 fraction < 0.02 (layer collapsed; stop, do not Bernoulli-substitute)
any region of h(i) has zero test units
vehicle ids used as FL clients
p_obs Bernoulli reintroduced on this EventTrace
